reasons.system: Requested by the operating system (prefers-contrast: more).

broker.title: MQTT broker
broker.description: LAN WebSocket connection · settings applied to the panel
broker.clientIdHint: Must be unique on the broker.
broker.demoHint: Simulates devices without opening sockets to the broker.

kiosk.title: Kiosk
kiosk.summary: Fade {{fade}} ms · clock at {{opacity}}% in sleep · {{mode}} every {{seconds}} s · touch guard {{guard}} ms.

pin.title: Panel PIN
pin.description: Protects loads, resets and critical scenarios
pin.errorLength: The PIN must contain 4 to 6 digits.
pin.errorMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pin.note: The PIN is stored as a bcrypt hash in the gateway database. Verification and the authoritative lockout are server-side; the panel adds a persistent local lockout as defense in depth.
pin.confirmDescription: Verification happens on the gateway; the new PIN never leaves the server.

raw.title: Topic test · RAW monitor
raw.description: Last {{count}} messages · in/out from the MQTT client
raw.empty: Waiting for messages… publish a test or wait for a telemetry update.

users.sessionNote: The profile comes from /api/auth/me, not from a file compiled into the bundle. Profile switching is verified by the gateway and the temporary session does not overwrite the kiosk refresh.

securityItems.pin: bcrypt PIN in the database only
securityItems.roles: Roles enforced on views and APIs

users.profilesHint: Pick the profile to use on this device (PIN required)
users.profilesReadOnly: Only an administrator or an elevated kiosk can switch profiles
users.note: Architecture note: roles and permissions are verified by the auth micro-service and enforced by the APIs. The restrictions shown here only hide or disable controls: a browser client is not a security boundary.

toasts.loadFailedDescription: The local gateway did not respond.
toasts.switchDeniedDescription: Only an admin or an elevated kiosk with PIN can switch profiles.
toasts.switchAction: The temporary session expires without revoking the device session.
